resourceName.description: customers/{customer_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}. Returned for the FROM resource even though it is not selected (observed on every row of a live n8n Q-G3 response, 2026-10-07).

id.description: INT64 as a decimal string. The campaign key of the daily fact row; parsed to an integer.

campaign.description: The FROM resource. Only campaign.id is selected; resourceName is always added by the API.

date.description: DATE as YYYY-MM-DD in the customer account time zone (customer.timeZone from Q-G1). Stored as Google's native date and never rebucketed.

segments.description: Segments of the row. Q-G3 segments by segments.date only, so each row is one campaign on one native Google day. Carries no resourceName.

costMicros.description: INT64 as a decimal string: cost in micros of the account currency (customer.currencyCode from Q-G1). Divided by 1,000,000 at parse time into numeric(18,6). Absent parses as 0.

impressions.description: INT64 as a decimal string. Absent parses as 0.

clicks.description: INT64 as a decimal string. Absent parses as 0.

conversions.description: DOUBLE as a JSON number, never assumed integral: data-driven attribution makes it fractional and MANY_PER_CLICK conversion actions allow several per click. Whole values arrive without a fractional part, and fractional values occur (both observed in a live n8n response, 2026-10-07). Parsed to Decimal, stored as numeric(18,6). Absent parses as 0. Google returns at most six decimal places (observed live 2026-10-07); a value finer than six places cannot be stored exactly in numeric(18,6) and is a parse defect.

conversionsValue.description: DOUBLE as a JSON number, the conversion value in the account currency. Absent parses as 0. Google returns at most six decimal places (observed live 2026-10-07); a value finer than six places cannot be stored exactly in numeric(18,6) and is a parse defect.

searchBudgetLostImpressionShare.description: DOUBLE fraction from 0 to 1. Optional and may be absent: it is omitted on rows where the metric does not apply (observed on some campaign-day rows of a live n8n response, 2026-10-07), and absent parses as unavailable, never 0. Google's metrics field reference notes this metric is reported in the range 0 to 0.9 and any value above 0.9 is reported as 0.9001 (0.9001 observed live, 2026-10-07); that sentinel is kept as returned. A value of 0.10 or more marks a capped day (AAP 0.5.4.1). Any other value is returned as a full double (often more than six decimal places, observed live 2026-10-07); the parser rounds it toward zero to six places for numeric(18,6), which keeps the 0.10 capped-day comparison exact.

searchImpressionShare.description: DOUBLE fraction from 0 to 1. Optional and may be absent: it is omitted on rows where the metric does not apply (observed live, 2026-10-07), and absent parses as unavailable, never 0. Google's metrics field reference notes this metric is reported in the range 0.1 to 1 and any value below 0.1 is reported as 0.0999 (0.0999 observed live, 2026-10-07); that sentinel is kept as returned. Any other value is returned as a full double (often more than six decimal places, observed live 2026-10-07); the parser rounds it toward zero to six places for numeric(18,6), which keeps every comparison with a six-place threshold such as 0.10 exact.

metrics.description: Daily metrics of the campaign. May be absent or partial, because REST JSON omits zero-valued or unset fields: absent additive metrics (costMicros, impressions, clicks, conversions, conversionsValue) parse as 0, and absent impression shares parse as unavailable.

body.description: One REST GoogleAdsRow of Q-G3: daily campaign metrics FROM campaign, bounded by segments.date BETWEEN the fetch range and carrying no status filter, so spend by a campaign removed during the window still counts. Rows arrive in results[] of the n8n webhook envelope governed by search.json (googleAds:search v25, camelCase keys, INT64 values as strings). Plan correction: campaign.id is added as the first select field, because a per-campaign daily row cannot be keyed without it; the query template makes the same addition. Google dates are in the customer account time zone (customer.timeZone from Q-G1) and are never rebucketed. A response of exactly 10,000 rows with no page token is split by halving the date range down to single days, then by halving an INT64 campaign.id range; Q-G3 has one row per campaign per day, so it cannot overflow at a single campaign and day (AAP 0.3.3). Field types were checked against the Google Ads API metrics and segments field references and a live n8n Q-G3 response (2026-10-07); the last-updated date of the v25 campaign fields page could not be read when this contract was written, so last_modified is null.
